name: ChannelSale – Sync Woo with Amazon, Walmart, Ebay, Wayfair + many more
author: ChannelSale

sections.description:
ChannelSale– Multi-Marketplace Automation for WooCommerce

Connect your WooCommerce store to Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Wayfair, Etsy, Newegg, Best Buy, Bed Bath & Beyond, Facebook, Instagram, Mercado Libre, Fruugo, Google Shopping, TikTok Shop, and 200+ additional marketplaces and sales channels from one centralized platform.

ChannelSale helps growing businesses simplify multi-channel selling by automating product listings, inventory synchronization, pricing updates, order management, and shipment tracking—reducing manual work, helping prevent overselling, and keeping every sales channel synchronized in near real time.

Start risk-free with our FREE Plan for Inventory & Order Sync and experience ChannelSale before upgrading.

Why Choose ChannelSale?

Managing multiple marketplaces shouldn’t mean managing multiple systems.

ChannelSale centralizes your marketplace operations into one easy-to-manage platform, allowing you to:
* Automate product listings across leading marketplaces
* Synchronize inventory in near real time
* Automatically import marketplace orders
* Sync shipment tracking updates
* Reduce manual work and operational errors
* Help prevent overselling
* Scale your marketplace business more efficiently

Every plan includes FREE fully managed onboarding, implementation, and setup by our marketplace specialists, helping you get started quickly and confidently.

Grow Marketplace Sales

Looking to expand beyond inventory and order synchronization?

Our marketplace specialists can create and optimize your product listings using industry best practices to help improve:
* Product visibility
* Marketplace search rankings
* Conversion rates
* Marketplace performance
* Long-term sales growth

Supported Integrations

Connect WooCommerce with leading marketplaces and sales channels, including:

Amazon ★ eBay ★ Walmart ★ Google Shopping ★ Facebook ★ Instagram ★ TikTok ★ Etsy ★ Wayfair ★ Bed Bath & Beyond ★ BestBuy ★ Newegg ★ Temu ★ Wish.com ★ Sears ★ Mercado Libre ★ Fruugo ★ Shopping.com ★ Pricegrabber ★ and many more

Key Features

  • Connect WooCommerce to 200+ marketplaces through a single integration
  • Synchronize product listings, inventory, pricing, orders, and shipment tracking
  • Near real-time inventory updates
  • Support for individual and variable products, bundles, kits, parent child variations
  • Marketplace-specific pricing and automated repricing support
  • Advanced business rules for product data and feed optimization
  • Custom product attributes for marketplace requirements
  • Multi-warehouse and multi-currency support
  • Integrations with shipping, inventory, fulfilment, and accounting systems
  • Detailed reporting and marketplace management tools

Why Businesses Choose ChannelSale

  • Trusted by online retailers since 2007
  • Millions of product listings synchronized across multiple sales channels
  • No setup fees for supported integrations
  • No sales commissions
  • Flexible month-to-month pricing
  • FREE managed onboarding and implementation
  • Dedicated marketplace specialists
  • Ongoing product enhancements and new marketplace integrations
  • Full ownership of your business data

Account Setup and Pricing

A ChannelSale account is required to activate the plugin. After confirming your requirements, our team will guide you through account creation and complete your managed onboarding.

  • FREE Plan available for Inventory and Order Sync (supports up to 15 orders per month)
  • Flexible paid plans designed for businesses of all sizes starting from $19/month
  • No long-term contracts
  • Flat-fee pricing with no commission on sales
  • Plans and pricing information click here to redirect to ChannelSale website pricing page

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 4.7 or greater
  • WooCommerce 2.6.0 or greater
  • PHP version 5.2 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

Support

Our experienced marketplace specialists are available to help with setup, onboarding, training, and ongoing support.
Toll-free phone +1-866-709-9495
Email: info@channelsale.com
Website: www.channelsale.com

sections.installation:
Getting started is quick and easy.

  1. Email support@channelsale.com to request your FREE managed setup.
  2. Our specialists will review your requirements to ensure ChannelSale is the right fit for your business.
  3. Once confirmed, we’ll send you an account activation link and guide you through the complete setup process—at no cost for the Free Plan.

Plugin Installation

  • Install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins page by selecting Add New and uploading the ChannelSale ZIP file, or
  • Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  • Activate the ChannelSale plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.

Our team is available to assist with installation, onboarding, and configuration to help you get up and running quickly.

Website: www.channelsale.com
sections.faq:
Does the plugin support creating product listings on marketplaces like Amazon, eBay and others?

Yes, plugin creates new product listings, updates existing listings on the marketplaces. Also supports variation listings.

Does it support sync Orders and Shipping updates from multi-marketplaces to WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin enables importing orders from multi-marketplaces into WooCommerce, and then sends back the shipping tracking updates from WooCommerce to the multi-marketplaces

Which marketplaces integrations are available?

Amazon ★ eBay ★ Walmart ★ Google Shopping ★ Facebook ★ Instagram ★ TikTok ★ Etsy ★ Wayfair ★ Bed Bath & Beyond ★ BestBuy ★ Newegg ★ Wish.com ★ Sears ★ Temu ★ Mercado Libre ★ Shopping.com ★ Pricegrabber ★ Fruugo ★ OnBuy many more

Is there a demo?

We can schedule a live demo meet, please email us your requirements on info@channelsale.com

What does the Free Plan include?

Free Plan available for Inventory and Order Sync. Includes sync inventory for up to 500 products on marketplaces and up to 15 orders per month.

What does the Free Trial plan include?

Free Trial includes the above features of Free Plan and includes creating sample product listings on any 1 marketplace Amazon, eBay or Walmart.

Pricing plans

View our pricing plans and contact us here.

What are the steps to install and activate plugin and where can I get support?

To activate WooCommerce plugin a ChannelSale account is required to be created, please contact us via email info@channelsale.com to proceed, or contact us here. After verifying that your requirements are met, our team will send you an email with the link to create the new account, we are happy to help!

Other queries

Please contact us via email info@channelsale.com, or here.
